product_metadata.title: Beistle British Photo Fun Signs, 5"-11.5", Multicolor
features: INCLUDES: 15 photo fun signs and 4 wooden dowels
MEASURES: Varying Sizes from 5 Inches to 11.5 Inches
Fun photo props to used for a British themed party

CELEBRATE LIFE WITH US: Since 1900 The Beistle Company’s mission has remained the same: to help people around the world celebrate life’s events by creating fun, high quality products using the finest materials
description: Beistle British Photo Fun Signs. The package contains 15 different pieces of British photo fun signs. The designs of the signs include a flag, bus, pipe, word bubble, guards hat, telephone booth, mustache, clock, umbrella, coffee cup, ring, crown, detective hat, top hat and an eyepiece. The signs are printed on both sides of board stock paper and measure from 5 Inch to 11.5 Inch. There are 4 wooden dowels included in the package which can be inserted into slits on the photo fun signs to hold up as photo props while getting photos taken. Use at your next British themed party!
